 P.S.TOJUDGE.
The petitioner is engaged in the trade of agricultural produce.
They had imported two consignments of betel nuts from Sri Lanka through Cochin Port.
Exts.P2 and P3 are the bills of entries filed by the petitioner for release of the consignments.
The consignments were however not released as the fourth respondent has not issued no-objection certificate as to the standard of the betel nuts imported by the petitioner.

The writ petition was filed, in the circumstances, seeking among others,
orders directing respondents 2 to 4 to take fresh samples from the consignments covered by Exts.P2 and P3 bills of entries and consider the bills of entries based on the test results of the fresh samples.
2. On 4.3.2016, this Court passed the following interim order:
"1. Petitioner makes a request to take fresh sample of Betel Nuts for sending it for lab analysis.
Learned Standing Counsel objected to such request.

It is submitted that fresh samples cannot be taken and in the light of Section 47 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the sample in the custody of the designated officer alone can be sent for analysis.

2. In the light of the above, there shall be a direction to the 3rd respondent to send sample in the custody of the designated officer for analysis and necessary fee and expenses for the same shall be met by the petitioner.
Report shall be obtained within a period of three weeks."

sentences.text: Pursuant to the said interim order, a report has been obtained by the fourth respondent from the Referral Food Laboratory, CFTRI, Mysore as to the standard of the betel nuts imported by the petitioner.
The said report which was placed on record in this case indicates that the samples collected pursuant to the interim order conforms to the prescribed standard.

3. In the light of the report of the Referral Food Laboratory, CFTRI, Mysore, the learned counsel for the respondents submitted that they have no objection in releasing the consignments of the petitioner.
In the result, the writ petition is disposed of directing respondents 2 and 3 to release to the petitioner the consignments covered by Exts.P2 and P3 bills of entries, forthwith.

Sd/-
P.B.SURESH KUMAR, JUDGE.
